summary: Frontend-only verification of kitchen data-entry idiot-proofing (Purchases, Issues, Stock-Take) and Overheads carry-forward. All 15 validation checks passed. No actual Saves were triggered on real dates; synthetic 2027-01-05 date used where applicable, and Overheads 'Save' button was never clicked (only disabled-state inspected).

issues: A 'Dispatch camp absentees' WhatsApp modal auto-pops over the Expense Report page on load, blocking view of the editor until dismissed. Not a validation bug but UX distraction when the admin only wants kitchen overheads.

critical_code_review_comments: MealsReport.jsx: ?tab=purchases and ?tab=issues are legacy deep-links only (no visible tab buttons in TABS array). If main agent wants chefs to still reach these, consider either adding tabs back or removing dead code paths.

The MealStockTakeTab physical-count 'count=0' case correctly keeps Save enabled, but note: 'stocktake-save' is still gated on summary.counted===0 — a sheet of all-zero counts is permitted (good), matches user spec of 'legit empty shelf'.

Front-end 'rate above 100000' is caught by purchase-invalid-note generic text ('row(s) need a valid qty & rate') — consider surfacing the specific 'Rate looks too large' message via tooltip to help the chef diagnose.
seed_data_creation: None. All edits were on far-future synthetic dates (2027-01-05) and were never Saved. Overheads editor fields were modified but Save was never clicked.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright flow: /login -> click 'Admin sign in with email' -> email+password -> Enter. Then goto /admin/meals-report?tab={purchases|issues|stocktake|expenses}. Purchases/Issues/Stock-Take all have 151 item rows via data-testid=purchase-qty-/rate-/row-, issues-qty-/row-, stocktake-physical-/rate-/row-. Overheads: data-testid meal-overhead-wages / meal-overhead-save / meal-overhead-carried / meal-overhead-carried-ro / meal-expense-month. CRITICAL: never click Save on current date — a whole-day overwrite wipes real kitchen data.
